in_sanskrit.name: Sharvakesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Power
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvakesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sharva is a God of power and Kesh is a long-haired God. Sharvakesh is a combination of these two names, meaning the God of all-powerful and long-haired.

in_hindi.name: Sharvakesh
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Power
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sharvakesh एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sharva is a God of power and Kesh is a long-haired God. Sharvakesh is a combination of these two names, meaning the God of all-powerful and long-haired.

in_tamil.name: Sharvakesh
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God of Power
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sharvakesh ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Sharva is a God of power and Kesh is a long-haired God. Sharvakesh is a combination of these two names, meaning the God of all-powerful and long-haired.

in_telugu.name: Sharvakesh
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God of Power
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sharvakesh ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Sharva is a God of power and Kesh is a long-haired God. Sharvakesh is a combination of these two names, meaning the God of all-powerful and long-haired.

in_marathi.name: Sharvakesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvakesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharva is a God of power and Kesh is a long-haired God. Sharvakesh is a combination of these two names, meaning the God of all-powerful and long-haired.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Power
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sharvakesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Sharva is a God of power and Kesh is a long-haired God. Sharvakesh is a combination of these two names, meaning the God of all-powerful and long-haired.
